result.title: EarthJev: Efficient Visual Evidence Acquisition and Decision for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
result.summary: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires locating fine-grained evidence in large scenes under limited visual input budgets. Active observation addresses this challenge through selective exploration, but repeated generative judgments can make region search costly. Its decisions also concern distinct prediction targets: spatial pointer validity, evidence presence, and reasoning correctness. We propose EarthJev, a framework that separates region scoring from answer generation and uses target-specific decision signals while keeping the answering model frozen. A spatial pointer verifier uses visual and geometric cues to guide exploration or bypass search. An evidence-aware decision mechanism scores compact candidate views in batches using a lightweight head on frozen representations, without generating textual region judgments. Format-specific confidence calibration then guides selection between candidate answers generated from memory and overview presentations of the acquired evidence. Across five benchmarks, EarthJev achieves a mean accuracy of 53.06% with Qwen3.5-9B, outperforming ZoomSearch with the same answering model by 2.33 to 14.73 percentage points per benchmark while reducing mean latency from 11.30 - 1.67 seconds per question. With four additional frozen answering models, model-specific fitting of the decision modules and calibration mappings yields mean accuracy gains of 3.41 - 6.53 percentage points over the corresponding single-pass baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Da1daidaidai/EarthJev

AI.brief_summary: EarthJev 面向超高分辨率遥感 VQA，将区域打分与答案生成分离，用空间指针验证器和基于冻结表征的批量证据筛选，配合置信度校准降低主动搜索成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及动态视觉证据获取与停止决策：其证据存在判断、搜索绕行和候选视图筛选可供核查 LOOK/STOP 的成本收益，但未涉及 latent 推理状态。
